exposure: Experience of care indicators (Person-Centered Maternity Care scale)
outcome: Experience of care scores (overall and by sub-scale)
cohort: 3953 women aged 15-49 years who gave birth within 9 weeks prior to the survey in Kenya, Ghana, and India
finding: There was insufficient evidence to suggest that women with obstetric complications report consistently better or worse experiences of care than women without.
mod_finding: Women who delivered by c-section reported consistently better experiences than women who delivered vaginally.
